title: RAW: one-buffer middle replacement with paid coordinates, escaped literals and preserved suffix
summary: A complete invented writer keeps only the previous decoded word. It either writes the next word literally with escape doubling, or gives a paid common-prefix length, deletion length and replacement middle while retaining the old suffix. Use the edit only when strictly shorter. This supplies an explicit source reader and distinguishes new literal payload; no source language or native value is assigned.

alphabet.written: The same22abstract marks. E=# is the escape mark. A=a is the edit opcode; b/c are binary0/1 and d terminates a number. These5roles are distinct. Other marks remain ordinary literals. No native workingunit has been assigned one of these roles.

complete_rule.literal: L(w) replaces EVERY source# by ## and leaves all other sourcecharacters unchanged. Its inverse requires every maximal #run to have even length and halves it.
complete_rule.numbers: B(n),n>=0, is canonical ordinary base2 with b=0,c=1, followed by terminator d. Zero is bd; positive numbers begin c and have no leading b. No numeric lengthcap. These are operator arguments, not native number meanings.
complete_rule.state: Keep exactly the previous decoded sourceword v, initially empty. This is an unbounded word buffer, a real memory cost, not a whole-word dictionary or hidden free state.
complete_rule.canonical_edit: For desired nonempty w, let p be longest common prefix length of v,w. Then let q be longest common suffix length subject to q<=min(len(v)-p,len(w)-p), preventing overlap with retainedprefix. Let delete=len(v)-p-q and middle=w[p:len(w)-q]. Candidate D(v,w)=#a B(p) B(delete) L(middle).
complete_rule.choice: Write D(v,w) iff its number of outputmarks is STRICTLY smaller than len(L(w)); otherwise write L(w). Ties use literal. The first word is necessarily literal because v is empty and editoverhead cannot save. After either branch replace buffer by w. No optional homophones or post-hoc exception.
complete_rule.reader: If group begins#a, read exactly2canonical binarynumbers terminatedbyd, then decode remaining escapedliteral middle. Require0<=p<=len(v),0<=delete<=len(v)-p. Set w=v[:p]+middle+v[p+delete:]. Require wnonempty and recomputed canonical encoder output equals the group; otherwise reject as outsidefixedwriter. If group does not begin#a, decode whole group throughL inverse, require nonempty and same canonical re-encoding equality. Updatebuffer onlyafteracceptance.
complete_rule.why_modes_unambiguous: A literal sourceword beginning# starts## in writing, never#a. Nonleading #characters are doubled. Thus the mode check does not confiscate sourcewords or silently reinterpret their initial letters. Empty insertedmiddle is legal; empty sourceword isnot.
complete_rule.distinctions: No sourceletters or common suffix are discarded: retainedprefix and suffix come from the paidbufferpositions, replacement middle is literal. This is source text preservation, not a free assumed paraphrase or glossary.
